sloka: तत्तु श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णस्य भाषितम् ।भ्रुकुटिं चैव सञ्चक्रे क्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत ।। ६.६३.२२ ।।
transliteration: tattu śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇasya bhāṣitam ।bhrukuṭiṁ caiva sañcakre kruddhaścainamabhāṣata ।। 6.63.22 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna having spoken that way, the ten headed Ravana frowned, shaking his eyebrows in anger and spoke this way.
